decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The development would result in the loss of a family sized unit (3b 5p minimum), thereby failing to comply with policy H11.1 of Merton Local Plan 2024

Reason : 2 - The proposed development fails to provide an adequate standard of internal living accommodation for future occupiers. The communal kitchen/living/dining area is insufficient in size to serve six residents and does not meet the expectations of the HMO Licensing Guidance or the HMO SPG, resulting in cramped and unsatisfactory living conditions. The proposal is therefore contrary to London Plan Policy D6 and Merton Local Plan Policy D12.3.

Reason : 3 - The proposal fails to provide detailed, secure, sheltered, well-lit and accessible cycle parking. The proposal therefore fails to comply with Policy T5 of the London Plan 2021 and Policy T16.2 of the Merton Local Plan 2024.

Reason : 4 - The application has not been accompanied by an Air Quality Neutral assessment or any supporting information to demonstrate that the proposed development would not adversely affect local air quality within an Air Quality Management Area. The proposal therefore fails to comply with London Plan Policy SI1 and Merton Local Plan Policy P15.10.

Reason : 5 - The proposal does not incorporate any biodiversity enhancement measures and is supported by a Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG) statement that does not accurately assess baseline habitat value or demonstrate any measurable net gain, the proposal therefore fails to comply with Policy G6 of the London Plan 2021 and Policy O15.3 of the Local Plan 2024.
description: CONVERSION OF SINGLE DWELLINGHOUSE INTO A C4 HMO FOR UP TO 6 PEOPLE, INCLUDING ERECTION OF A SINGLE STOREY REAR EXTENSION, REAR DORMER ROOF EXTENSION AND ASSOCIATED WORKS.
